==Description==
The '''Mini Accelerator Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy. It was made by Juniper Creates™. The plushie offers the default Level 5 [[Accelerator]] skin. Anybody who bought the toy from the in-game Merch Store will receive the {{Color|Other|Plushie}} skin for the [[Accelerator]]. If bought on the [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games store], it will not come with any rewards.

The gun and energy canisters are detachable. It is made out of plush fabric, Polypropylene cotton and felt. It is 5.5 inches wide, 7.9 inches tall and 5.5 inches deep, or 13.97 centimetres wide, 19.812 centimetres tall and 13.97 centimetres deep. A tree is planted for every order of the '''Mini Accelerator Plush'''.

==Official Description==
*'''Online (Second)'''
*:Compact, agile, and ready for action. The Mini Accelerator is built to join your squad and bring speed and power to your collection. This plush does not include an in-game reward.
*'''Online (First)'''
*:Compact, agile, and ready for action. This plush is built to join your squad and bring speed and power to your collection. The in-game reward is only included with purchases made in Roblox. Items purchased from shop.paradoxum.games do not include an in-game reward. 

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''Mini Accelerator Plush''' could be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] or the in-game Merch Shop for $26.99.
